blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: India ranks among the world's 17 mega-diverse countries.
The country accounts for approximately 8% of the world's recorded biodiversity.
The Western Ghats and Northeast India are critical centers of endemism.
India boasts an extensive conservation network with over 100 National Parks and 550+ Wildlife Sanctuaries.

blocks.content: • Contains about 8% of recorded global biodiversity.

items: Questions frequently test India's global biodiversity percentage (approx. 8%).
Identify the two major centers of endemism in India: Western Ghats and Northeast India.
Note the official count of protected areas: 100+ National Parks and 550+ Wildlife Sanctuaries.
